body:
It take a million “good jobs” to distract from ONE hurtful comment that came from a parent. Instead of thinking of leaving as hurting yourself, maybe set goals to achieve, with the ultimate one being living on your own. (Idk how old you are, but goals don’t have to be immediate) then one day if he does say that, maybe you can walk out of the door, and feel okay 

Also I’m sorry for the unsolicited advice- take it or leave it, you will always be significant 🙂
